_: Generated by running the board's own parseTask, serializeTask and parseDoc, the same way the repeat: and message tables were. `roundTrip` is what serializeTask writes for a task the board has touched, so the tag order on write is pinned as well as the reading; core/todo.py has no serialiser and checks `expect` alone. A rank the board could not read is written here as null — JavaScript actually holds NaN for it, which serializeTask drops and Python never produces, so null is the one answer both can agree on.
